scientific.integrity: All six section coordinates and all 96 node coordinates are reconstructed from the published formulas and checked with exact arithmetic in Q(i). The proof does not rely on floating-point numerics or on the source's one-witness-per-node table for the complete incidence relation.
limitations: Minimality is only among the six section images P1, P2, P6, P1', P2', P6' used by Burek; no universal lower bound for arbitrary resolution centers is claimed.
The incidence computation concerns the 96 ordinary double points and not the two transversal A2 singularity curves.
The result does not classify alternative global small resolutions.

title: All six section divisors are necessary in Burek's 96-node cover
